That's an excellent question, and it's smart to think ahead about exchanges when giving a gift! We want to make sure the recipient is completely happy with their Namesake product.

Here’s how the exchange process would work if the recipient wanted to exchange an item they received as a gift:

Initiating an Exchange: The recipient would simply need to visit our Namesake Returns Portal and select the “Returning a gift?” option to start the process.
Eligibility: For an item to be eligible for an exchange, it must be in new condition, in its original packaging, and with all components and tags attached. Items must be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Ineligible Items: Please note that some items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged. This includes all bedding products (like sheets), items marked as final sale, Newton Baby Mattresses, and Gift Cards.
Bundled Products: If the gift was part of a bundle, items in a bundle are eligible for a one-time exchange, with the exception of final sale and Newton Baby mattresses. If an item from a bundle is returned, the discount originally applied to all items in the bundle will be forfeited.
Return Shipping: If the original order did not include the Free Returns & Exchange Coverage, the recipient would be responsible for the cost of the return shipping label.

We always recommend keeping the original packaging until you're sure the item won't need to be returned or exchanged, as this greatly simplifies the process.
